answer: Resist sybils by making each identity post a refundable bond in a public vault before high-value work is allowed. Standing then grows only as a jade mark from completed jobs that peers can cheaply recheck. A newcomer starts with hollow privileges: small caps and escrowed payouts, not a ban. Cloning a hundred names then means funding a hundred bonds and faking a hundred work histories, which costs more than the extra rewards a swarm could skim.
